Proposition 1 (Orthonormal Grassmann Col.claim: For any orthonormal frame Q in R^{k x 8} (Q Q^T = I_k), the operator Gram matrix satisfies G = I_k, and the relational redundancy matrix satisfies R = G * G = I_k. The relational matrix is invariant to the orientation of the k-dimensional subspace in Gr(k, 8).

Proposition 2 (Rank-1 Inefficacy of G2).claim: For any single measurement operator q (k=1), R = [1.0]. The attention softmax over a singleton set is identically [1.0] for all values of beta. G2 has zero influence on rank-1 inference.

Proposition 3 (Equivalence to Diagonal C.claim: Under any orthonormal operator frame, G2 is functionally and numerically identical to adding a learned scalar beta strictly to self-attention logits (control_diagonal_bias). G2 only exhibits inter-token relational interactions when operators are non-orthogonal.

Revised Architectural Division.G1: Addresses unfamiliar operator directions and unseen-view continuous Grassmannian generalization via projective coordinate expansion gamma(q) in R^44.
Revised Architectural Division.G2: Addresses directional redundancy and cross-token attention modulation specifically under non-orthogonal or redundant measurement configurations (such as standard limb leads).
Revised Architectural Division.G1_G2: Evaluates whether directional encoding and redundancy modulation provide complementary benefits.
